full_details: Davy Gannet took a penny at the stair and said Raleigh was gone for gold, the Spaniard was in Kent, and it would rain. He had it as forty ships and the Queen's blessing. A sailor said Guiana was where men have their heads in their chests. You said you had met such men in the City. It did not rain. At nine the company walked a pass. You were not in the Knave at two, and you did not go back. Kemp stayed civil. No tally was opened. On Sunday's unsent leaf you added the forty sail, and you still did not send it. At supper a scarred gunner swore the kitchen pots of Guiana were beaten gold. Bryan said a man who knew the road would go quietly. Kemp asked, with great respect, why the gunner was in Bishopsgate. Alice put him out, chart and all, when he took a doubt for disloyalty. On the tables you wrote that gold is surer the further it is.
one_sentence: You heard at the Old Swan that Raleigh had gone with forty ships, rehearsed at nine, and at the Split Hazel saw a chart put out of the room.
title: Forty ships, and a chart at supper
